csv_project_name: IQC A/E service Districtwide Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: A Design-Build process for the 2026 BRIDGE REPLACEMENT PACKAGE PROJECT, which will consist of a total of four individual bridge replacement projects. Carriage Hills MetroPark Historic Farm Bridge the replacement of an existing single-span, timber A-Frame bridge (15 -6 + 29 -4 + 15 -4 = 60 -2 total length) supported by combination stone/concrete abutments with a single-span, steel bridge with the same A-Frame layout (either structural or aesthetic) to preserve the same historic looking bridge. Taylorsville MetroPark s Great Miami River Trail Bridge #1 the replacement of a cast-in-place four-sided box culvert (12 -0 x 6 -0 ) with a precast concrete, foursided box culvert (12 -0 x 6 -0 ) per ODOT Item 611 Conduit, Type A, 706.05 along with cast-in-place inlet weir walls and (precast/cast-in-place) outlet concrete headwall/wingwall). Taylorsville MetroPark s Great Miami River Trail Bridge #2 the replacement of a single-span, steel beam bridge (20 -6 span) with concrete deck (including footings) with a precast concrete, four-sided box culvert (size to be determined by DBT) per ODOT Item 611 Conduit, Type A, 706.05 (size to be determined by DBT) including (precast/cast-in-place) inlet/outlet headwall/wingwall. Aullwood Garden MetroPark s Marie Aull Wooden Bridge the replacement of a single span, timber arch bridge (30 -0 long) supported by combination stone/concrete abutments with a steel beam (ADA compliant & similar arch style) bridge with wood deck and steel rails posts and railings
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

relevance_explanation:
- Bridge projects are generally relevant to sbp, and this package includes multiple replacement structures.
- The tender is design-build and explicitly requests structural engineering, creating a planning component.
- However, all structures are small-scale replacements with short spans of about 20 ft, 30 ft, and 60 ft, plus culverts.

- Historic appearance and ADA-compliant replacement add some design interest, but overall technical ambition is modest.
